description: Eight step sequencer with a knob per step, a gate output per step, a randomize trigger and an end-of-cycle trigger

params.text: Sets how many steps play before the sequence returns to the first, 1 to 8
Sets the voltage this step sends to the cv output, over the range picked on the menu
Sets all eight step knobs to new random values

inputs.text: A rising edge advances to the next step
A rising edge returns the sequence to step 1, taking effect on the next clock pulse while the clock input is patched
A rising edge sets all eight step knobs to new random values

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger each time the sequence returns to its first step
The voltage of the knob for the current step, over the range picked on the menu, and 0V while the clock input is unpatched
Carries 10V while the sequence is on this step and 0V otherwise, and holds whatever it last carried while this step is above the number set by the steps knob

notes: the cv and eoc outputs hold 0V until a clock is patched; the eight step gate outputs follow the current step whether or not a clock is patched.
menu: range — sets the voltage span of the step knobs and the cv output: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own
